subject: MAP update and short extension request — acceptance gating & ownership
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP update and short extension request — acceptance gating & ownership

Hi Jonathan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our plan I attached Novus-MAP-v3.pdf which consolidates the evaluation plan and the proposed acceptance gates. A couple of clarifying items before we lock dates:

- Acceptance gates: staged (pilot -> limited production -> full go-live). Each gate has a 72‑hour observation window.
- Ownership: we’ve assigned engineer points-of-contact for each gate in the MAP (see bottom of page 2).
- Contingency: if procurement or security review delays the PO, we propose a short, scoped pilot (limited tokens, dedicated model variant) to keep technical validation on track.

Can you confirm whether ProcureCo needs any additional artifacts this week (SOC 2 evidence, network diagrams, or a vendor addendum)? If procurement requires more time, would Novus be open to a 7–10 day shift to the demo + pilot start while we keep the technical pilot date we proposed?

If you prefer, I can propose a rebaseline spreadsheet with alternate dates and the ownership matrix — happy to pull that together by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tessa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
attachments: Novus-MAP-v3.pdf
From: Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@novushealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureCo Contracts <contracts@procureco.com>
Date: 2027-11-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP update and short extension request — acceptance gating & ownership

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A quick procurement update: our vendor team pushed back this morning and asked for a completed SOC 2 checklist and a network diagram before they can approve the PO. The earliest they gave is a two-week review window because they’re batching vendors this cycle.

We can do the technical pilot sooner (engineering ready), but procurement will not sign the PO until their review completes. Would Redwood be able to hold the pilot slot with limited access until procurement clears? If not, we’ll need to push the pilot start by ~14 days.

Also copying contracts; they may request an updated SOW.

—Jonathan
Director, Platform Integrations | NovusHealth
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, ProcureCo Contracts <contracts@procureco.com>
Date: 2027-11-12T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP update and short extension request — acceptance gating & ownership

On Thu, Nov 11, 2027 at 11:03 AM, Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@novushealth.com> wrote:
> Tessa —
> 
> Appreciate the clear MAP. A quick procurement update: our vendor team pushed back this morning and asked for a completed SOC 2 checklist and a network diagram before they can approve the PO. The earliest they gave is a two-week review window because they’re batching vendors this cycle.
> 
> We can do the technical pilot sooner (engineering ready), but procurement will not sign the PO until their review completes. Would Redwood be able to hold the pilot slot with limited access until procurement clears? If not, we’ll need to push the pilot start by ~14 days.

Thanks for the update, Jonathan. We can absolutely run a short technical pilot ahead of PO signature under a constrained access plan — limited token/timebox and a short confidentiality addendum (standard). That will preserve your engineering validation while giving procurement time.

I’ve sketched a rebaseline proposal (attached: rebaseline-proposal.xlsx) with two paths:
1) Conservative (procurement-driven): shift pilot + demo by 14 days; acceptance gates slide with new lock dates.
2) Pilot-first (recommended to avoid losing momentum): pilot starts on original technical date with limited access; demo and PO completion still target the later procurement clearance date.

Request to Novus: please confirm which path you prefer by COB tomorrow so we can lock dedicated capacity and confirm engineers. If you pick Pilot‑first we’ll require a signed short-form pilot agreement and a single point of contact for incident triage.

Marissa and Rishi — tagging you to confirm we have capacity to hold the limited pilot slot and to approve the pilot SOW version.

Best,
Tessa
attachments: rebaseline-proposal.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@novushealth.com>, ProcureCo Contracts <contracts@procureco.com>
Date: 2027-11-13T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP update and short extension request — acceptance gating & ownership

Tessa / team / Jonathan —

Quick leadership note. We can accommodate a one-week extension without changing committed resources. Beyond that, we need a firm PO / SOW commitment or we will have to release the reserved pilot slot to another pipeline customer. Two operational asks if Novus selects Pilot‑first:

1) Pilot SOW signed (short-form) and PO intent (email from procurement) by Nov 19.
2) Single incident contact and scheduled weekly sync (30m) for the duration of the pilot.

If procurement truly needs 14 days, we’ll accept a two-week slide but will require a rebaseline decision and a signed commitment plan (DocuSign link below) to hold production capacity after the demo. Jonathan — if Novus agrees, Rishi will prepare the short-form pilot SOW and we’ll circulate the DocuSign tonight.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Novus-DEAL-8719 (placeholder)

Marissa
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jonathan Lee <jonathan.lee@novushealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ProcureCo Contracts <contracts@procureco.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized MAP path and ownership matrix — pilot-first agreed

Jonathan / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per Jonathan’s update and Novus confirmation this afternoon, we are moving forward with the Pilot‑first path. Final agreed items below (this is the canonical MAP update):

- Path: Pilot‑first (technical pilot starts 2027-11-18 as originally scheduled; limited access).
- Pilot SOW: short-form pilot SOW (attachment: MAP-ownership-matrix.csv) — Rishi to send DocuSign by EOD 11/16.
- Procurement: Novus will complete SOC 2 checklist and PO approval by 2027-11-30; ProcureCo copied here for any immediate evidence requests.
- Capacity: Redwood reserves a limited dedicated slot until 11/30, after which full capacity is conditional on PO receipt.
- Acceptance gates: Pilot observation window: 72 hours; limited production window contingent on PO.
- Ownership: Tessa (Customer Success) — pilot coordination; Rishi — SOW/contract; Marissa — capacity & executive escalation; Jonathan (Novus) — procurement contact/PO tracking.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Rishi: send DocuSign + pilot SOW (due 2027-11-16) — COMPLETED.
- Jonathan / ProcureCo: SOC 2 checklist & PO (due 2027-11-30).
- Tessa: kickoff pilot plan & engineering rota (due 2027-11-17).

Deal record: DEAL-8719 updated in HubSpot.

Attachments: MAP-ownership-matrix.csv, Novus-MAP-v3.pdf

Cheers,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
